description: This is a C source file for the LanManager component, responsible for managing LAN events, sysevent notifications, and starting LAN/bridge services in a network device.

methods.name: Get_LnmThreadType
methods.description: Maps a string event name to an internal enum representing the event type.

methods.name: LNM_SysCfgGetInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer configuration value from syscfg.

methods.name: LAN_start
methods.description: Starts LAN or bridge services based on current configuration.

methods.name: LNM_sysevent_threadfunc
methods.description: Thread function that listens for sysevent notifications and triggers appropriate actions.

methods.name: Lan_Manager_Init
methods.description: Initializes the LAN manager, opens sysevent connection, and starts the notification thread.

methods.name: findProcessId
methods.description: Finds the process ID of a given process name.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Daemonizes the process on Linux systems.
